name: CrewLayoverAccommodationPlanner
tagline: Airline crew hotel desk in one control – rooming, rest checks, pickups and contracted allotment.
description: Plan crew layover accommodation end to end: rooming list with auto-assign to contracted hotels, booking workflow board, layover timeline with rest segments, hotel allotment and rate-cap checks, suggested pickups and rest-rule, room-clash and confirmation alerts. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Rest check per layover (debrief + transfer + pickup)
Suggested pickup from outbound and report time
Unconfirmed bookings inside the confirm window
Contracted hotels with rate cap, allotment and transfer time
Auto-assign cheapest contracted hotel with rooms left
Book the whole pairing at one hotel
